Name: Ashish Kumar
Bio: Ashish Kumar is a Founder of Plaksha University. Ashish Kumar is the Managing Partner and CIO at Infinity Alternatives. Prior to founding Infinity Alternatives, Ashish was the India Head for PineBridge Investments. He has also worked at Bank of America. Ashish has a BTech from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | BTech, Computer Science, IIT Delhi
